APPROVE. The refactor keeps the logic identical (the direct `)` check, the same loop bounds, `-1` on `;`/`{`/`}`, `k - 1` on `:` after `)`, and the same final lookup), and both methods are now well under 15 in cognitive complexity. It should still build, since the helper is a private static in the same class and uses the same `MaxReturnTypeTokens` constant.

I reviewed the diff only; I did not build it or run the tests.
